criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: FID 196 is named Hall of Data Science and AI/DSAI. The modeled wall ring is copied from the official building GIS local-meter ring; the source bounds are X -129.857..-65.900 m and Y 139.662..210.935 m. Validated geometry expands by under 0.2 m where façade details protrude. Raw ArcGIS FID196 JSON is preserved.
criteria.finding: Footprint matches by direct source reuse. No independent aerial/top-down overlay is included to confirm that the correct registered polygon ring represents all as-built wings.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: The asset remains in campus world coordinates using the project local approximation. Horizontal evaluated bounds are within roughly 0.2 m of the given registered bounds. The registered polygon carries its orientation and plan scale directly into the wall ring.
criteria.finding: No separate transform comparison or north-up footprint overlay was saved. Position is supported by direct conversion from the source geometry, but not independently rechecked against an aerial or surveyed coordinate reference.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Purdue GIS identifies four levels and the model presents four occupied façade bands. Final max Z is 13.4 m. The source record correctly calls storey heights and roof masses estimates and notes undocumented units in GIS height-like fields. Reference photos support red clay hipped roofs.
criteria.finding: There is no measured height source. The roof is three large overlapping simplified hips; rendered intersections create broad, awkward roof planes that do not follow the clear individual wings seen in MSKTD’s exterior photo. No roof-plan or aerial comparison justifies the current roof extents and peaks.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: The render shows red masonry, pale limestone horizontal courses, dark glazed windows, and a terracotta roof, which agree at a broad level with the architect image.
criteria.finding: The model omits a convincing front entry/stone portal, vertical limestone corner piers at the prominent facade corner, and the strong distinction between the large punched lower-level windows and tall, close-spaced upper-storey glazing visible in the architect reference. Current fenestration is uniformly repeated. The upper storey appears capped by a low slab-like roof mass. Main exterior image is a single distant oblique render and shows no useful interior/circulation.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Stable asset filename and exported collection are retained; all 45 mesh objects are inside the building collection. The `.blend` freshly reopened in Blender 5.2.3. Dedicated audit folder contains source URLs, raw FID196 JSON, downloaded architect/Purdue reference photos, validation report, and render. Asset has no external texture file dependency.
criteria.finding: Evidence record includes source CRS and uncertainties, but does not state individual photograph retrieval dates/source publication dates or provide a perimeter/top-down/interior saved review view. The interior details are only schematic and not exposed in the exterior review.

findings: Below the 8/10 pass threshold. Correct the roof intersections/extents and bring the entry, corner treatment, and upper-storey window rhythm closer to the architect reference. Add an independent top-down footprint/position view and an interior/circulation view.
Model bounds and collection/object counts are taken from the saved asset validation. Height and interior circulation remain estimates.
